scope: Accepted 1858–1859 batch-17 source-text rendering, attribution, receipt and missing-list recovery requirements only; candidate for root review. No converter, transcript, corpus, training, export or accepted-evidence changes.

requirements.requirement: Render DCP-LETT-2249 as a partial Gray witness. P1 is an editorial synopsis of the 146-genera list and must never be emitted as Gray prose or as list rows. Preserve only the surviving qualified Gray statement in P2 and the signature in P3; do not reconstruct species, counts, handwriting, or the lost covering note. The broad XML lower bound is not a composition date.

evidence.quote: Of course I suppose most of the above are truly & originally distinct; some are probably not; a few pretty surely not.

requirements.provenance: The recovery probe found no independent DAR 165:103 facsimile; its earlier 1855 CUDL list is a comparison only.

requirements.requirement: Keep Darwin’s April 4 response separate from the missing Gray answer and list. The body establishes receipt of the letter/list by the preceding day and Darwin’s tabulation, while P2 says Hooker and other botanists differ from Gray and think varieties were omitted in small genera; that reported view must not be attributed to Gray. Preserve the distinct future sheet request and the qualified composition/read-through claims.

evidence.quote: how delighted I was to get your list, which is now being tabulated
Hooker & several (not all) other Botanists differ from you

requirements.requirement: Keep Gray’s June 21 firsthand observations in the body separate from Darwin’s dated August 16 annotation. Gray reports that he has never noticed bees visiting flowers before they open; this is his observation and does not assert universal absence. The August annotation records Darwin’s later B. hortense/Adlumia observations and must carry marginal provenance, not Gray voice or a fabricated receipt date.

evidence.quote: whom I have never yet noticed about a Fumariaceæ

requirements.requirement: Render Darwin’s July 4 response with its actual preserved diagram as a separate visual asset. The body answers the missing May 21 Gray note; do not substitute 2288 merely because both discuss flowers. P4’s Wallace receipt/forwarding discussion and request for the date of a 1857 sketch are separate scopes, and later editorial/publication material must not be merged into the Darwin body.

evidence.quote: I have not answered your note of May 21

requirements.visual_rule: Use the preserved figure manifest and source DOM image locator; describe the two-nectary versus one-nectary schematic, not measured anatomy.

requirements.requirement: Keep missing July 27 and December Gray prompts explicit. 2321’s climate/migration discussion includes qualified hypotheses and answers an unlocated July 27 note; 2364 asks about complexion/fever evidence without a recovered prompt. 2520 is a November 11 prospective Origin dispatch/reading request and explicitly limits Darwin’s prior Japan Flora reading. 2592 and 2599 are December post-endpoint material and must remain held outside the period; their missing long Gray letter and Japan memoir cannot be used as period knowledge.

evidence.quote: I have directed a copy of my Book (as yet only an abstract) on the Origin of species to be sent you

requirements.date_rule: Do not convert a missing prompt or later publication/annotation into a received contemporary source.

implementation_boundary: Documentation only. Do not implement a converter, alter frozen source/projection files, revise accepted notes/decisions/ledgers, create transcripts, or export RAFT examples.

Keep body paragraph numbering from the retained corpus projection separate from raw DOM XPath. Retain editorial synopsis, annotations, bibliography and recovery provenance as research layers, never correspondent prose.
notes: The accepted batch-17 decision holds the 2249→2252 relationship source-incomplete and corrected its direction concept: 2252 is Darwin’s response; 2249 does not contain the list text.
2252’s receipt evidence is April 3, but 2252 composition is April 4; receipt, composition and reading must remain distinct.
The 2302 diagram and the August 16 annotation on 2288 require separate visual/marginal provenance.
